# report_qor -delay -max_density -slack_lesser_than -10

report_qor is an Innovus command that reports Quality of Results metrics.

Syntax:
  report_qor
    [-delay]
    [-max_density <float>]
    [-slack_lesser_than <float>]

Parameters:
  -delay (bool, optional): Report delay information.
  -max_density (float, optional): Maximum density threshold.
  -slack_lesser_than (float, optional): Report paths with slack less than this value.

Examples:
  report_qor
  report_qor -delay -max_density 0.8
  report_qor -slack_lesser_than -10.5
